purpose: Canonical truth source for WPA certificate and card security. It preserves the earlier multi-layer anti-fake design while separating design-ready controls from controls that are actually active in production.

public_boundary.rule: A rendered card, certificate, serial, seal, hash or QR graphic never creates status. Only an authorised registry record may establish status after the corresponding production controls are activated.

legacy_source.truthfulness_note: Legacy sample URLs, hashes, PKI fields and status values are examples and must not be interpreted as currently active infrastructure.

security_layers.label: Authoritative registry record
security_layers.control: Every issued credential or active card must resolve to one canonical registry record with immutable public ID and governed status history.

security_layers.label: Human Gate authorisation
security_layers.control: No credential or membership status may transition to ISSUED or ACTIVE without recorded Human Authority approval.

security_layers.label: Registry-generated serial
security_layers.control: Serials are generated by the registry, not typed into artwork. Prototype serials remain DEMO/TEST only.

security_layers.label: Verification URL + QR
security_layers.control: QR payload contains only a verification URL or opaque token; it must not embed sensitive personal data.

security_layers.label: Cryptographic content digest
security_layers.control: A SHA-256 or equivalent digest binds the rendered artifact to the authorised registry record and version.

security_layers.label: PDF digital signature / PKI
security_layers.control: Where legally and technically appropriate, final PDFs may be digitally signed using managed keys and auditable signing procedures.

security_layers.label: Live status and revocation
security_layers.control: Public verification must show at minimum valid status, revocation/suspension state, supersession and last update.

security_layers.label: Status-change audit log
security_layers.control: Every material change records actor, timestamp, reason and previous/new state; public view exposes only the minimum necessary.

security_layers.label: Verification anti-abuse monitoring
security_layers.control: Rate limits, anomaly detection and security logging protect the verification service without exposing unnecessary personal data.

security_layers.label: Controlled visual security design
security_layers.control: Navy/gilt/cream hierarchy, micro-layout, seal zones and other visual details may deter casual copying but must never be described as cryptographic or tamper-proof security on their own.

prototype_rules: All sample IDs must be marked DEMO or TEST unless backed by an authorised live registry record.
Prototype QR graphics may point only to a clearly labelled demo verification route.
No prototype seal, signature image, hologram effect or serial may imply governmental, accreditation or legal status.
No public claim of PKI, live hash verification or anti-fraud monitoring may be made until independently verified in production.
